review_scope: Coordinate and coordinate-provider-ID admission families in frozen v4, v6, v7 packets; no code, candidate, or release mutation.
read_only_policy: Only review.json and notes.md in this assigned output directory were written.

A_rural_exact_code_plus_own_name_type.scope: 2021 DaData via Tochno settlement point plus FIAS binding only where source/provider raw OKTMO agree exactly after terminal .0 removal, own name and full type are exact, FIAS level is 6, ID and point are unique, coordinates are valid WGS84 and no known baseline conflict exists. Treat as a contemporary source point; no earlier-year continuity inference.
limitations: provider query receipt/measurement date is absent in all 100 sampled candidate rows; record time/replay limitation without treating it as an automatic contradiction.
Six of 100 did not have an exact-coordinate baseline corroboration; all six still pass source-point and no-known-conflict gates.

B_strict_name_plus_external_context.scope: Same strict provider/source row checks as A rural plus exact-code, exact-label, physically scoped Wikidata context; external binding and DaData point remain separate claims.
limitations: Wikidata TSV/module/truthy cache are one lineage and counted once.
Only 9/100 sampled rows also have an exact GeoKLADR code/name label; GeoKLADR is a dated 2011 corroboration, not a universal gate.

C_wikidata_physical_source_city_point.scope: Physical city settlement source grain; exact unique source OKTMO to one QID/P764, exact Russian source-name label, a physical settlement P31/P279 ancestry path, and one valid Wikidata P625 point in expected source ADM1. This admits a representative point claim; it does not claim a city boundary or select a point where multiple claims/conflicts remain. No FIAS binding is implied.
holds: Five physical city source rows have multiple eligible P625 points; retain both claims but do not select one representative point.

Of the 13 inherited provider-distance conflicts, 11 are corroborated by the exact-code/name/city-type 2011 GeoKLADR point (and by independent current ADM1 membership); retain only Mezhgorye and Ust-Kut as unresolved coordinate-choice holds. These legacy flags are risk leads, not a contradiction to the newly checked Wikidata point.
limitations: An exact-city polygon is unavailable; accepted point claims are representative settlement points, not footprints.
The accepted 11 cross-source points are corroborated by dated 2011 GeoKLADR same-code city context; this supports same locality, not identical point choice or unchanged boundaries.

A_urban_level4_physical_code_name_point_.scope: Physical city source row plus exact OKTMO-linked unique QID, exact label, physical P31/P279 path and one P625 point in expected source ADM1. Provider FIAS level-4 binding is checked separately against exact source/provider OKTMO and uniqueness; no claim of city extent.
holds: Five records have two eligible P625 alternatives; hold point choice until a defensible representative-point selection is available.
limitations: Candidate boolean `candidate_review_gate_clear` incorrectly holds four candidates because an admin-only P31 class co-occurs with at least one independently checked physical P31/P279 path. The physical path wins for settlement-object scope; details and corroborating GeoKLADR points are below.

source_row_reconciliation.method: Used each source_row as the 1-based row locator into the frozen raw parquet; independently compared source object level/name, source OKTMO, raw region, population, raw provider FIAS ID/level, provider OKTMO and provider latitude/longitude.
source_row_reconciliation.field_checks_passed: 405/405 for every compared field; no mismatches.

wikidata_raw_claim_reconciliation.method: Followed the frozen raw source_file/line_number locators and directly reread gzip JSONL records; checked property and exact value for P625, exact P764, and P31.
wikidata_raw_claim_reconciliation.p279_type_paths: Independently traversed pinned 458-entity wbgetentities P279 graph; every one of the 100 C-sample and 100 widened A-city sample entities had at least one P31 path to a physical-settlement anchor. P31 may also have administrative classes; the entity is held only when no physical path is present.
wikidata_raw_claim_reconciliation.independence_note: Wikidata TSV, module, truthy cache and P31/P279 metadata are not treated as independent providers. P625 is a Wikidata point claim; P764 is a Wikidata code claim.

modern_adm1_screen.source_date: 2017 ADM1; simplified physical-region check, not settlement/city polygon.
modern_adm1_screen.method: Independently evaluated point coordinates with Shapely covers() against expected ADM1 geometry; source region-to-ADM1 mapping manually normalized for standard region names and alias cases.
modern_adm1_screen.provider_sample: 205/205 A/B/v4 urban sample source points were inside expected ADM1.
modern_adm1_screen.wikidata_city_samples: 102/102 candidate point records for C sample and 102/102 for widened A-city sample were inside expected ADM1; each sample represents 100 source rows, with extra records arising from multi-point QIDs.
modern_adm1_screen.interpretation: Regional location check only; it cannot resolve which city point is representative.

geokladr.review_use: An independently versioned 2011-era code/name/type/point context. The reviewed receipt reports every raw DBF row matching its parsed export; this review did not duplicate the DBF parser. No population values or legal event semantics are imported.

admin_only_type_candidates.interpretation: Each candidate has co-occurring administrative class Q56061, but also a concrete physical P31 class and P279 path to a physical settlement anchor. The gate is too broad when it treats any admin-only P31 as excluding the QID despite physical P31 evidence.

provider_id_binding_risk_in_C_cohort.meaning: Keep affected FIAS provider-ID bindings held; this does not negate a separately checked Wikidata point claim. Thirteen baseline point-conflict rows also receive coordinate-choice holds.

targeted_holds.known_city_coordinate_conflicts_interpre: These 13 flags compare the selected DaData provider point to another baseline coordinate and do not themselves contradict the newly checked physical Wikidata point. Exact same-code/name/city-type GeoKLADR points are in the expected ADM1 for 12/13; 11 are within 4.035 km of the Wikidata point. Only Mezhgorye (22.571 km) and Ust-Kut (no exact-code historical point) remain held for point choice. The historical classifier-region text is not an exact match for the current census region on all 12 joined rows; I checked the historical points themselves against the expected current ADM1 geometry instead (12/12 inside).

fixed_seed_sample_ids.sample_note: 400 primary fixed sample rows across four rule strata, plus all five v4 exception candidates. This is a fixed stratified audit, not a probability sample and provides no national error-rate or precision estimate.

limitations: No coordinate corrections or candidate admissions were written.
Exact source ADM1 membership does not establish exact city extent, entrance, centroid, or census-date boundary.
DaData/Tochno missing query receipts limit request-time/replay traceability; coordinates remain attributed to the frozen source dataset.
Wikidata is a single provider family. A true but differently situated P625 may still be a poor representative point.
P17 was treated as metadata only; Crimea points remain physically eligible when code/name/type and physical region conditions pass.
Eleven legacy provider-distance risk rows were resolved by matching GeoKLADR 2011 code/name/type points; the old risk flag is retained in the audit record but is not treated as a veto.
